_comment: Canonical Robinhood Chain mainnet data used by contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol and config/chains.ts. Every address was taken from the linked official source AND verified on-chain (see docs/RATE_SOURCES.md for the probe results). Do not edit without re-verifying.
name: Robinhood Chain

USDG_USD.heartbeatNote: Feed updates every 24h exactly (measured over 8 rounds, 2026-10-09); 26h used so trading is not blocked in the seconds before each update.

SYRUPUSDG_USDG_EXCHANGE_RATE.source: https://github.com/maple-labs/maple-docs/pull/157 (integrate/crosschain/syrupusd-crosschain.md, Robinhood Chain tab); on-chain description() = 'syrupUSDG / USDG Exchange Rate'

SEQUENCER_UPTIME.source: Not available on Robinhood Chain (Chainlink L2 sequencer uptime feeds do not list it). OracleAdapter keeps the check pluggable.

rateSources.description: Steakhouse USDG - Morpho Vault V2 (on-chain USDG lending rate)
Spark Savings USDG (Sky savings rate, T-bill-backed collateral base)
Maple syrupUSDG (institutional credit, bridged; Maple exchange-rate feed)
rateSources.initialRateSource: Maple feed growth over last 7/30 rounds = 4.85%/4.88% (2026-10-09)

gaps: No tokenized T-bill / money-market fund token (BUIDL, USTB, OUSG, USDY, BENJI) is deployed on Robinhood Chain as of 2026-10-08. ChainlinkRateSource accepts any NAV/exchange-rate feed so one can be added via MarketFactory once issued.
No Chainlink L2 sequencer uptime feed on Robinhood Chain; OracleAdapter.setSequencerFeed can enable it later.
syrupUSDG is a bridged token on Robinhood Chain; its index comes from Maple's on-chain exchange-rate feed (updated from Ethereum), not a local ERC-4626 share price.
